feature_queries.name: facility_geo
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.facility_id,
  e.timestamp,
  f.country,
  f.state,
  f.city
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN facilities f
  ON f.facility_id = e.facility_id

feature_queries.name: facility_study_history
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.facility_id,
    e.timestamp,
    fs.nct_id,
    fs.date AS fs_date
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN facilities_studies fs
    ON fs.facility_id = e.facility_id
   AND fs.date < e.timestamp
), joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.facility_id,
    b.timestamp,
    b.nct_id,
    b.fs_date,
    s.enrollment,
    s.study_type,
    s.phase,
    s.number_of_arms,
    s.number_of_groups
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN studies s
    ON s.nct_id = b.nct_id
)
SELECT
  facility_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT nct_id) AS n_prior_studies,
  COUNT(*) AS n_facility_study_rows,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', fs_date, timestamp)) AS avg_days_since_fs,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', fs_date, timestamp)) AS min_days_since_fs,
  MAX(DATE_DIFF('day', fs_date, timestamp)) AS max_days_since_fs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs_date >= timestamp - INTERVAL '1 year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_studies_last_1y,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs_date >= timestamp - INTERVAL '3 year' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_studies_last_3y,
  AVG(enrollment) AS avg_enrollment,
  approx_quantile(enrollment, 0.5) AS med_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN study_type = 'Interventional' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_interventional,
  SUM(CASE WHEN study_type = 'Observational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_observational,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase LIKE 'Phase 1%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_phase1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase LIKE 'Phase 2%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_phase2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase LIKE 'Phase 3%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_phase3,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phase LIKE 'Phase 4%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_phase4,
  AVG(number_of_arms) AS avg_number_of_arms,
  AVG(number_of_groups) AS avg_number_of_groups
FROM joined
GROUP BY facility_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: facility_outcome_analysis_history
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.facility_id,
    e.timestamp,
    fs.nct_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN facilities_studies fs
    ON fs.facility_id = e.facility_id
   AND fs.date < e.timestamp
), oa AS (
  SELECT
    b.facility_id,
    b.timestamp,
    oa.p_value,
    oa.param_value,
    oa.dispersion_value,
    oa.date AS oa_date
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN outcome_analyses oa
    ON oa.nct_id = b.nct_id
   AND oa.date < b.timestamp
)
SELECT
  facility_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS n_outcome_analyses,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p_value IS NOT NULL AND p_value < 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_p_lt_005,
  AVG(p_value) AS avg_p_value,
  approx_quantile(p_value, 0.5) AS med_p_value,
  AVG(param_value) AS avg_param_value,
  AVG(dispersion_value) AS avg_dispersion_value,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', oa_date, timestamp)) AS min_days_since_oa
FROM oa
GROUP BY facility_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: facility_sponsor_history
feature_queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    e.facility_id,
    e.timestamp,
    fs.nct_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN facilities_studies fs
    ON fs.facility_id = e.facility_id
   AND fs.date < e.timestamp
), sp AS (
  SELECT
    b.facility_id,
    b.timestamp,
    ss.sponsor_id,
    ss.lead_or_collaborator
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN sponsors_studies ss
    ON ss.nct_id = b.nct_id
   AND ss.date < b.timestamp
)
SELECT
  facility_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sponsor_id) AS n_unique_sponsors,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lead_or_collaborator = 'lead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_lead_sponsor_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lead_or_collaborator = 'collaborator' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_collab_sponsor_rows
FROM sp
GROUP BY facility_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: time_features
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  facility_id,
  timestamp,
  EXTRACT(year FROM timestamp) AS asof_year
FROM eval_table
